name: Check in / out (profiles: checkinout, cellar, library)
info:
Start the edge with ./start.sh --profile cellar (or library,
checkinout). The stock is kept in this flow's context (flow.stock: code -> {qty, place, out}); put it in
DigitalHome.cloud instead with an http request after 'stock'.

name: stock
the stock again
func:
const stock = flow.get('stock') || {};
return { payload: Object.values(stock).reduce((n, x) => n + x.qty, 0), tile: 'stock' };
